english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for “now” at the present time.
This is the all-purpose spoken Hong Kong Cantonese equivalent for saying something is true now or at present.
Use 而家 when English “here” means that something is now present or happening.
Use this for “actually” meaning “currently” or “at the moment,” not for emphasis or correction.

examples.english: I need to go to work now.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 faan1 gung1

examples.english: I am currently doing homework at home.
examples.traditional: 我而家喺屋企做緊功課。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 uk1 kei2 zou6 gan2 gung1 fo3
ji4 gaa1 jau5 wai2 haak3 hai2 dou6

examples.english: I'm actually in a meeting at the office right now.
examples.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 ngo5 hai2 gung1 si1 hoi1 gan2 wui2
